text:
Hi there, and thanks for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Our support email address is **help@leafy.example**. We answer emails within **1 business day**.

If you'd like a faster reply, there are a couple of other options:
- **Chat:** 8am-8pm, Monday to Saturday (your local time)
- **Plant Care Specialists:** chat 9am-5pm, Monday to Friday (your local time), for free plant care advice

Please note we don't offer phone support.

Is there anything else I can help you with today? Happy growing! 🪴
